start.text: Emergency routes cut through the city like they own it.

follow-response.text: Stay behind the response. Let them open the road.

hold-route.text: Do not lose the route. The destination matters more than speed.

reach-destination.text: We made the lane. Now we get out before anyone remembers us.

complete.text: Clean route. Clean exit. Good work.

travel.text: Emergency routes cut through the city like they own it.

start.text: Reed can tell us what the stolen car left behind.

recover-vehicle.text: I have the car. Keep it running and keep it intact.

return-intact.text: Return it to Reed. The vehicle tells us where the thieves went.

complete.text: You brought it back in one piece. That gives us something to work with.

travel.text: Reed can tell us what the stolen car left behind.

start.text: Somebody picked the wrong person to corner.

reach-contact.text: Get behind me. We are leaving together.

protect-contact.text: Protect the contact, but do not turn a street problem into a war.

survive-encounter.text: Contact is clear. I am still standing.

travel.text: Somebody picked the wrong person to corner.

start.text: Two units? Fine. Let us see which ones can actually keep up.

trigger-pursuit.text: You are about to have their full attention.

lose-first-unit.text: First unit is off the trail. One more.

clear-search.text: Search is clear. Nobody saw where we went.

complete.text: That was close. Lose the heat before the next move.

travel.text: Two units? Fine. Let us see which ones can actually keep up.

start.text: The record disappears if we wait.

locate-record.text: Find the locker before someone finds us.

secure-record.text: Secure it. Nothing else in this building matters.

leave-territory.text: Leave police territory. Evidence only helps if it survives.

complete.text: The record is safe. That is enough for tonight.

travel.text: The record disappears if we wait.

start.text: They are coming for the witness. We have to reach them first.

reach-witness.text: Stay with me. We are getting you out.

escort-witness.text: Keep moving. Do not look back.

safe-exit.text: Witness is clear. Get them somewhere quiet.

complete.text: They are safe. Nobody had to get hurt.

travel.text: They are coming for the witness. We have to reach them first.

trigger-response.text: Every unit in the city is about to become interested in you.

reach-safehouse.text: Safehouse reached. Five stars can stay behind us.

complete.text: That was too close. Do not make a habit of it.

start.text: We have a tail. Do not acknowledge it.

detect-tail.text: Watch the pattern, not the car.

identify-tail.text: Once you know who is following, you can choose where they stop following.

break-surveillance.text: Surveillance broken. They are looking at an empty route.

complete.text: Good. Now we decide what they were trying to learn.

travel.text: We have a tail. Do not acknowledge it.

start.text: We solve this without giving the city another reason to remember us.

assess-risk.text: Check every option before touching the one that creates noise.

resolve-cleanly.text: Quiet resolution. No unnecessary witnesses, no unnecessary heat.

confirm-no-wanted.text: No new wanted points. That is the result we needed.

complete.text: Clean hands are useful when everyone else is leaving fingerprints.

travel.text: We solve this without giving the city another reason to remember us.

start.text: The broker wants a meeting. Let us give him one.

meet-broker.text: Do not show urgency. The access is worth more than the conversation.

negotiate-access.text: We have terms. Now give us the token.

obtain-token.text: Token secured. The restricted network is no longer out of reach.

complete.text: Now that is a door worth opening.

travel.text: The broker wants a meeting. Let us give him one.
